arxiv_papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv_papers.title_en: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv_papers.title_zh: DeepSeek-R1：通过纯强化学习激发大模型复杂推理能力的训练范式
arxiv_papers.spec: GRPO 算法 · 零监督 SFT 冷启动
arxiv_papers.spec_en: GRPO Algorithm · Zero SFT Cold Start
arxiv_papers.summary_zh: 开创性证明仅需纯强化学习即可涌现高难度数学与逻辑自我反思能力，无需海量昂贵的人工标注数据。
arxiv_papers.summary_en: Groundbreaking demonstration that pure reinforcement learning can directly incentivize complex mathematical reasoning and self-reflection without expensive human SFT data.

arxiv_papers.title: Scaling Laws for Test-Time Compute in Large Language Models
arxiv_papers.title_en: Scaling Laws for Test-Time Compute in Large Language Models
arxiv_papers.title_zh: 大语言模型测试期计算（Test-Time Compute）扩展定律研究
arxiv_papers.spec: Test-Time Scaling · 推理期算力兑换
arxiv_papers.summary_zh: 系统证明通过延长模型在推理阶段的思考步数与树搜索空间，可显著超越增加百倍预训练参数带来的增益。
arxiv_papers.summary_en: Proves that scaling search and reflection during inference can significantly outperform 100x pretraining parameter scaling.

arxiv_papers.title: V-JEPA 2: Towards General Video World Models with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
arxiv_papers.title_en: V-JEPA 2: Towards General Video World Models with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
arxiv_papers.title_zh: V-JEPA 2：基于联合嵌入预测架构的通用物理视频世界模型
arxiv_papers.spec: 非自回归 · 物理空间感知
arxiv_papers.summary_zh: 抛弃逐像素扩散生成，在特征潜空间直接预测物体运动轨迹与受力交互，为具身智能奠定物理常识基础。
arxiv_papers.summary_en: Abandons pixel-by-pixel generative diffusion to predict motion trajectories and physical dynamics directly in latent space.

arxiv_papers.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
arxiv_papers.title_en: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
arxiv_papers.title_zh: SWE-agent：基于终端与文件系统专用接口的自主软件工程智能体
arxiv_papers.spec: SWE-bench 生产级 · 终端自主执行
arxiv_papers.summary_zh: 设计专为大模型交互优化的 Shell/文件浏览器界面，实现自动化解决真实 GitHub 复杂 Issue 的工程闭环。
arxiv_papers.summary_en: Specially designed Agent-Computer Interfaces that allow LLMs to autonomously browse codebases, run tests, and fix real GitHub issues end-to-end.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大厂高管天天在国会与聚光灯前渲染“AI可能自主发动末日级网络战毁灭人类”，网安一线的白帽子专家终于忍不住掀桌子了。天天拿科幻末日剧本忽悠议员要监管特权与豁免金牌，现实中连最基础的内网鉴权与漏洞挖掘机理都解释不清。把自身工程架构的疏漏强行神话为“超级AI黑客”，既掩盖了安全治理的失职，又顺便贩卖了一波末日焦虑。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Industry Insight: Reflects the ongoing transition towards sustainable deployment, commercial maturity, and balanced governance across the AI ecosystem.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大厂高管天天在国会与聚光灯前渲染“AI可能自主发动末日级网络战毁灭人类”，网安一线的白帽子专家终于忍不住掀桌子了。天天拿科幻末日剧本忽悠议员要监管特权与豁免金牌，现实中连最基础的内网鉴权与漏洞挖掘机理都解释不清。把自身工程架构的疏漏强行神话为“超级AI黑客”，既掩盖了安全治理的失职，又顺便贩卖了一波末日焦虑。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 选民大多不喜欢人工智能和数据中心，但两党似乎都没有优势。 调查反映出AI高耗能算力设施在地方落地时正面临严峻的电力供应、土地资源及公众环境关切阻力，AI基建扩张正在从单纯的技术投资转变为敏感的公共与政治议题。

news.title_zh: Meta计划在今年秋天发布一款无摄像头智能眼镜；这款新机型有六个麦克风，用户可以与Meta的人工智能聊天机器人和Muse对话。
news.summary_zh: Jyoti Mann /信息： Meta计划在今年秋天发布一款无摄像头智能眼镜；新模式

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta计划在今年秋天发布一款无摄像头智能眼镜；这款新机型有六个麦克风，用户可以与Meta的人工智能聊天机器人和Muse对话。 该举措主要旨在解决公共场合摄像头带来的隐私争议，同时降低硬件成本与佩戴门槛，加速以音频和语音为核心的多模态AI助手渗透至日常消费场景。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 全球产业与技术前沿一线, Meta (扎克伯格团队) advanced a key development: Meta plans to release a camera-free pair of smart glasses this fall; the new model has six mics to let users speak with Meta's AI chatbot and Muse. Context: 该举措主要旨在解决公共场合摄像头带来的隐私争议，同时降低硬件成本与佩戴门槛，加速以音频和语音为核心的多模态AI助手渗透至日常消费场景。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI在IPO前考虑以1.2万亿美元的估值融资。 巨额融资意向凸显出头部模型公司在研发前沿架构与构建超级计算集群过程中巨大的资本消耗率，企业正力求在公开上市前锁定充沛流动性以构筑壁垒。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 全球产业与技术前沿一线, OpenAI 官方团队 advanced a key development: OpenAI mulls funding round at $1.2 trillion valuation ahead of IPO, FT reports. Context: 巨额融资意向凸显出头部模型公司在研发前沿架构与构建超级计算集群过程中巨大的资本消耗率，企业正力求在公开上市前锁定充沛流动性以构筑壁垒。

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 奥特曼又来重新定义人类货币单位了。在还没实现规模盈利甚至现金流还在疯狂燃烧的前提下，直接把私募估值开到了1.2万亿美元。这架势像极了：“只要我融钱的速度快过烧钱的速度，地心引力就追不上我。” 资本市场一边骂泡沫太疯狂，一边又生怕错过下一轮，只能一边闭着眼掏钱一边祈祷IPO时有更大的接盘侠。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Industry Insight: Reflects the ongoing transition towards sustainable deployment, commercial maturity, and balanced governance across the AI ecosystem.

news.title_zh: TypeSafe AI正在开发一种模型，该模型可以输出带有概率估计的数字响应，以帮助企业评估可靠性，该公司筹集了4000万美元的种子资金
news.summary_zh: Rashi Shrivastava /福布斯： TypeSafe AI，它正在开发一个模型，输出概率为e的数值响应

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: TypeSafe AI正在开发一种模型，该模型可以输出带有概率估计的数字响应，以帮助企业评估可靠性，该公司筹集了4000万美元的种子资金。 降低开发者微调与工程落地的门槛与算力开销，加速端到端应用在真实业务中生根发芽。

Context: 降低开发者微调与工程落地的门槛与算力开销，加速端到端应用在真实业务中生根发芽。

elements_zh.why: 降低开发者微调与工程落地的门槛与算力开销，加速端到端应用在真实业务中生根发芽。

news.title_zh: OpenAI支持两党共同努力解决人工智能生物威胁
news.summary_zh: OpenAI支持两党共同努力解决人工智能生物威胁

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI支持两党共同努力解决人工智能生物威胁。  调查反映出AI高耗能算力设施在地方落地时正面临严峻的电力供应、土地资源及公众环境关切阻力，AI基建扩张正在从单纯的技术投资转变为敏感的公共与政治议题。

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 科技巨头在国会作证时言必称“星辰大海与人类未来”，然而地方选民只关心一件事：“我家电费账单怎么又涨了？你们那嗡嗡响的机房到底要吞多少地下水？” 当AI遇上现实的水电账单和地方选票，科技乌托邦瞬间被打回原形。两党谁也不敢打包票，毕竟谁也不想在拉票时被老乡质问：“你到底是支持我们吹空调，还是支持大模型通宵刷题？”

news.title: Crypto exchange CoinEx says it is closing, citing a lengthy downturn and rising compliance costs; a report said it moved $3B+ for Iran-linked wallets since 2019 (Dylan Tokar/Wall Street Journal)
news.title_en: Crypto exchange CoinEx says it is closing, citing a lengthy downturn and rising compliance costs; a report said it moved $3B+ for Iran-linked wallets since 2019
news.author: Wall Street Journal
news.content_snippet:
Dylan Tokar / Wall Street Journal:
Crypto exchange CoinEx says it is closing, citing a lengthy downturn and rising compliance costs; a report said it moved $3B+ for Iran-linked wallets since 2019  —  CoinEx says it is ceasing operations less than three months afte
news.summary_en:
Dylan Tokar / Wall Street Journal:
Crypto exchange CoinEx says it is closing, citing a lengthy downturn and rising compliance costs; a report said it moved $3B+ for Iran-linked wallets since 2019  —  CoinEx says it is ceasing operations less than three months afte
news.title_zh: 加密货币交易所CoinEx表示正在关闭，理由是长期低迷和不断上升的合规成本；一份报告称，自2019年以来，它为与伊朗相关的钱包转移了30多亿美元
news.summary_zh: Dylan Tokar/《华尔街日报》： 加密货币交易所CoinEx表示正在关闭，理由是长期低迷和不断上升的并发症

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 加密货币交易所CoinEx表示正在关闭，理由是长期低迷和不断上升的合规成本；一份报告称，自2019年以来，它为与伊朗相关的钱包转移了30多亿美元。 加密货币交易所CoinEx表示，由于长期低迷和合规成本上升，它将关闭；一份报告称，与伊朗有关的钱包转移了30多亿美元。 行业核心力量围绕“加密货币交易所CoinEx表示正在关闭，理由”加速推进关键技术攻坚与工程落地，力求在激烈的产业竞赛中确立先发优势。

news.title: AI ‘Actor’ Tilly Norwood Told Me That ‘All Lives Matter’
news.title_en: AI ‘Actor’ Tilly Norwood Told Me That ‘All Lives Matter’
news.author: Wired AI
news.content_snippet: The virtual character, which is promoting its upcoming movie Misaligned, tries to evade politics by repetitively commenting on the clothes you’re wearing.
news.summary_en: The virtual character, which is promoting its upcoming movie Misaligned, tries to evade politics by repetitively commenting on the clothes you’re wearing.
news.title_zh: 人工智能“演员”蒂莉·诺伍德（ Tilly Norwood ）告诉我“所有生命都很重要”
news.summary_zh: 这位虚拟角色正在宣传即将上映的电影《Misaligned》，试图通过反复评论来逃避政治

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 人工智能“演员”蒂莉·诺伍德（ Tilly Norwood ）告诉我“所有生命都很重要”。 为了宣传即将上映的电影《错位》，这个虚拟角色试图通过反复评论你穿的衣服来逃避政治。 生成式数字人与虚拟演员渗透演艺工业引发行业伦理与从业者权益博弈，算法在敏感议题上的回避机制暴露出防御性对齐的技术短板。

news.title: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch:
India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift  —  India has finally put a price on larger transactions on its ubiquitous
news.summary_en:

news.title_zh: 从10月15日起，印度的UPI将对超过2000卢比（21美元）的某些付款征收0.4%的商户费，这是一个重大转变。
news.summary_zh: 印度的UPI一直对商户免费，但将对某些收费收取0.4%的商户费

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 从10月15日起，印度的UPI将对超过2000卢比（21美元）的某些付款征收0.4%的商户费，这是一个重大转变。 该调整标志着核心数字基础设施正告别长期的免费补贴模式，通过向高频商业结算收取增值服务费以分摊高昂的结算与算力基础设施运维成本。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 印度移动金融与大额数字支付市场, 印度统一支付接口 (UPI / NPCI) advanced a key development: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift. Context: 该调整标志着核心数字基础设施正告别长期的免费补贴模式，通过向高频商业结算收取增值服务费以分摊高昂的结算与算力基础设施运维成本。

news.title: GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs (David Welch/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet:
David Welch / Bloomberg:
GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs  —  General Motors Co. is integrating Apple Inc.'s CarPlay in its latest infotainmen
news.summary_en:
David Welch / Bloomberg:
GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs  —  General Motors Co. is integrating Apple Inc.'s CarPlay in its latest infotainmen
news.title_zh: 通用汽车计划将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车（Android Auto）加入其最新的信息娱乐系统，三年前，通用汽车将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车从其电动汽车中移除，令一些消费者感到不满。
news.summary_zh: 大卫·韦尔奇/彭博社： 通用汽车计划在三年前将Apple CarPlay和Android Auto添加到其最新的信息娱乐系统中

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 通用汽车计划将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车（Android Auto）加入其最新的信息娱乐系统，三年前，通用汽车将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车从其电动汽车中移除，令一些消费者感到不满。 通用汽车重新引入手机互联映射方案，表明封闭自研车机在抗衡成熟移动生态心智时遭遇现实阻力，顺应用户对无缝导航与音频交互的刚需成为保障终端口碑的务实选择。

Context: 通用汽车重新引入手机互联映射方案，表明封闭自研车机在抗衡成熟移动生态心智时遭遇现实阻力，顺应用户对无缝导航与音频交互的刚需成为保障终端口碑的务实选择。

news.title_zh: OpenAI表示，它已经与Anthropic和谷歌在人工智能安全方面合作了几周，而且它不需要反垄断豁免来协调安全问题。
news.summary_zh: OpenAI表示，它已经与Anthropic和谷歌在人工智能安全方面合作了几周

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI表示，它已经与Anthropic和谷歌在人工智能安全方面合作了几周，而且它不需要反垄断豁免来协调安全问题。 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

news.author: Politico
news.content_snippet:
Brendan Bordelon / Politico:
OpenAI backs a provision of the FRONTIER Act, a bipartisan House proposal, that would require AI companies to embed outside evaluators to ensure model safety  —  Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI is supporting a bipartisan House pro
news.summary_en:
Brendan Bordelon / Politico:
OpenAI backs a provision of the FRONTIER Act, a bipartisan House proposal, that would require AI companies to embed outside evaluators to ensure model safety  —  Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI is supporting a bipartisan House pro
news.title_zh: OpenAI支持《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，该条款是众议院两党提出的一项提案，要求人工智能公司嵌入外部评估人员，以确保模型安全。
news.summary_zh: OpenAI支持《边境法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，这是众议院两党提出的一项提案

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI支持《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，该条款是众议院两党提出的一项提案，要求人工智能公司嵌入外部评估人员，以确保模型安全。 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 美国国会听证会与联邦监管审议现场, 美国众议院 (U.S. House of Representatives) advanced a key development: OpenAI backs a provision of the FRONTIER Act, a bipartisan House proposal, that would require AI companies to embed outside evaluators to ensure model safety. Context: 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 科技巨头在国会作证时言必称“星辰大海与人类未来”，然而地方选民只关心一件事：“我家电费账单怎么又涨了？你们那嗡嗡响的机房到底要吞多少地下水？” 当AI遇上现实的水电账单和地方选票，科技乌托邦瞬间被打回原形。两党谁也不敢打包票，毕竟谁也不想在拉票时被老乡质问：“你到底是支持我们吹空调，还是支持大模型通宵刷题？”

celebrity.title: Pieter Levels: Vibe coding is completely real. Built and launched a full native SaaS in 48 hours using Cursor and Claude, crossed $10k MRR on day one. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures.
celebrity.title_en: Pieter Levels: Vibe coding is completely real. Built and launched a full native SaaS in 48 hours using Cursor and Claude, crossed $10k MRR on day one. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures.
celebrity.title_zh: Pieter Levels：氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。我用 Cursor 和 Claude 在 48 小时内从零构建并上线了一款完整的原生 SaaS，首日 MRR 突破 1 万美元。现在的开发者不再写语法细节，而是在指挥架构设计。
celebrity.quote_zh: 氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。现在的独立开发者不再逐行扣语法细节，而是在用大模型指挥整体架构设计。
celebrity.quote_en: Vibe coding is completely real. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures and prompt product vision.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。

这个周末我做了一个极限挑战：完全不手动编写任何一行底层 CRUD 语法，仅使用 Cursor 搭配最新的 Claude 模型，在 48 小时内从零构建并上线了一款全功能原生跨端 SaaS 应用。

结果令人震撼：产品发布第一天，月经常性收入（MRR）就直接突破了 10,000 美元。

我的核心体会：
1. 编码范式已被彻底重写：你不需要记住具体框架的繁琐 API，大模型对代码库上下文的掌握远比人脑快；
2. 架构决策权依然在人：模型会犯错，但只要你懂系统骨架、数据流与业务闭环，给它精准的约束边界，它能以人类百倍的速度把功能落实为可运行代码；
3. 一人超级公司的时代正式到来。
celebrity.full_text_en:
Vibe coding is completely real.

This weekend I ran an extreme experiment: without writing a single line of raw CRUD boilerplate syntax by hand, using only Cursor paired with the latest Claude model, I built and launched a full-stack native cross-platform SaaS in 48 hours.

The result is staggering: on day one after launch, it crossed $10,000 in monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

My key takeaways:
1. The programming paradigm is officially broken and rebuilt: you no longer need to memorize framework API idiosyncrasies; LLM context comprehension is orders of magnitude faster than human lookup;
2. Architectural decisions remain human: models make mistakes, but as long as you understand system skeletons, state pipelines, and business loops, giving precise boundaries allows it to materialize working code at 100x speed;
3. The era of the one-person billion-dollar company is here.

celebrity.title_en: Mckay Wrigley: We officially have a zero-latency Jarvis running completely local on Mac. Multi-agent voice system orchestrating your browser and IDE with no cloud API.
celebrity.title_zh: Mckay Wrigley：我们终于在 Mac 芯片上实现了 100% 本地脱机运行的零延迟 Jarvis 语音助手。多智能体系统完全在端侧协同接管浏览器与开发工具，不走任何云端 API。
celebrity.quote_zh: 我们终于在普通消费级 Mac 芯片上，跑通了 100% 本地脱机运行、端到端零延迟的私人 Jarvis 智能体。
celebrity.quote_en: We officially have a zero-latency Jarvis running completely local on consumer Mac silicon without touching a single cloud API.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我们终于在普通消费级 Mac 芯片上，做出了真正堪比钢铁侠 Jarvis 的多智能体语音助手。

最硬核的一点是：它不需要连接任何云端网络，零 API 费用，端到端延迟低到近乎自然人类对话。

系统技术栈构成：
- 本地语音唤醒与双工转录：基于自研量化 Whisper 实时流处理；
- 核心推理引擎：端侧量化 32B 开源基座，运行在 Mac M4 Max 的 Unified Memory 架构上；
- 动作执行：通过本地系统自动化脚本直接编排浏览器、VSCode 和终端。

当你开口说话时，它能边听边打断，瞬间在屏幕上调度三个 Agent 分工查资料、重构代码并跑通测试。未来计算的形态正在从‘点击输入’彻底转向‘自然多模态伴生’。
celebrity.full_text_en:
We officially have a real-time Jarvis running completely offline on consumer Mac silicon.

The most hardcore part: zero cloud connection, zero recurring API bills, and end-to-end latency that feels identical to natural human voice interruption.

Stack breakdown:
- Streaming duplex voice ingestion: localized quantized Whisper;
- Brain: local quantized 32B open weights running across Apple Silicon unified memory;
- Action execution: localized accessibility and shell integration orchestrating Chrome, VSCode, and git.

When you speak, it listens and interrupts with zero awkward silence. Multi-agent swarms execute tasks across your screen in real time. The paradigm is officially shifting from keyboard clicks to seamless multimodal symbiosis.

celebrity.title: Alex Albert: Engineers are using Claude hybrid reasoning mode with MCP servers to autonomously debug 100,000-line legacy codebases overnight.
celebrity.title_en: Alex Albert: Engineers are using Claude hybrid reasoning mode with MCP servers to autonomously debug 100,000-line legacy codebases overnight.
celebrity.title_zh: Alex Albert：工程师们正通过 Claude 混合深度推理模式搭配 MCP 协议，让智能体在夜间自主排查并重构超过 10 万行代码的陈旧复杂系统。
celebrity.quote_zh: 混合深度推理与标准化 MCP 协议的结合，让智能体在夜间自主排查并重构 10 万行遗留系统的成功率从不可行跃升至量产可用。
celebrity.quote_en: Pairing hybrid reasoning with standardized MCP servers lifts the success rate of autonomous 100k-line refactoring from impossible to production-grade.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
过去 24 小时收到大量工程师团队的震撼实测反馈：

当我们将混合深度推理（Hybrid Thinking）与模型上下文协议（MCP）组合后，智能体的工程破障能力发生了质变。

以前让模型重构一个十几万行的大型工程，模型往往在翻了五六个文件后陷入‘注意力迷失’或臆想函数；
现在，工程师通过配置 GitHub MCP 与本地测试执行器 MCP：
1. 模型首先会在思考链中自主绘制整个模块的调用依赖拓扑图；
2. 自主编写单元测试捕获边缘边界；
3. 一旦代码测试报错，模型会在推理空间反复自我博弈，定位是依赖版本错位还是逻辑越界，而不是直接无脑输出一堆毫无意义的修正重试。

昨晚有团队让它自主跑了一整夜，清理掉了积累 3 年的 47 个历史遗留并发竞态 Bug。软件工程的重构成本已被彻底改写。
celebrity.full_text_en:
The feedback from engineering teams over the last 24 hours has been nothing short of extraordinary:

When pairing hybrid reasoning with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic problem-solving undergoes a phase shift.

Previously, attempting to refactor a 100k-line codebase caused models to lose context coherence after five file reads, hallucinating non-existent imports.
Now, by combining a GitHub MCP with a localized test-runner MCP:
1. The model maps architectural dependencies inside its dedicated thinking token space first;
2. Autonomously writes test harnesses capturing edge boundaries;
3. When test runs fail, it self-debates in reasoning trace rather than blindly spewing randomized patches.

One team left an agent running overnight and woke up to 47 long-standing concurrency race condition bugs cleanly resolved with green test suites.

celebrity.author: Swyx (Shawn Wang)
celebrity.title: Swyx: Context caching economics have quietly flipped the entire SaaS business model upside down. Agents with million-token caches cost pennies to run continuously.
celebrity.title_en: Swyx: Context caching economics have quietly flipped the entire SaaS business model upside down. Agents with million-token caches cost pennies to run continuously.
celebrity.title_zh: Swyx：上下文缓存（Context Caching）的极低成本优势，正悄然将传统企业 SaaS 商业模式连根颠覆。常驻百万 Token 上下文的智能体，现在连续运行只需几美分。
celebrity.quote_zh: 上下文缓存带来的量级降本，正悄然将传统企业软件的商业根基连根拔起：常驻百万上下文的智能体，连续运转的边际成本已近乎为零。
celebrity.quote_en: Context caching economics have quietly flipped enterprise software upside down: keeping million-token agents running continuously now costs mere pennies.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
许多人还没有算明白上下文缓存（Context Caching）在经济模型上引发的剧震：

在此之前，每一次给大模型喂入几十万字的业务代码、法律合同或用户历史对话，都要按全额 Input Token 计费。一个需要频繁查询庞大知识库的复杂智能体，一天调用几十次成本就可能高达几十美元。

现在，主流供应商（Gemini, DeepSeek, Anthropic）的缓存命中折扣普遍高达 80%~90%：
- 你可以把全公司的 API 手册、历史代码库乃至全部内部知识库长期‘热驻留’在大模型显存中；
- 智能体随叫随到，每轮交互只需支付极微小的新增 Token 成本；
- 这意味着：以前按‘坐席订阅费’收取每年几十万美元的传统企业内部知识库软件，其护城河一夜之间被降维打击为廉价的缓存通道。

软件的商业模式正在从‘卖功能许可’彻底转向‘算力套利与价值分成’。
celebrity.full_text_en:
People haven't run the math on the sheer economic earthquake caused by Context Caching:

Previously, every single call that fed large codebases, legal contracts, or conversation trees incurred full input pricing. A complex agent querying knowledge bases 50 times a day could easily rack up tens of dollars daily.

Now, with cache hit discounts universally reaching 80% to 90%:
- You can keep entire enterprise repositories and documentation warm in model memory around the clock;
- Agents respond with zero reload penalty and marginal fees for incremental tokens;
- This evaporates the moat of traditional enterprise software charging six-figure seat licenses for glorified search indexing.

SaaS economics are permanently shifting from feature subscriptions to compute arbitrage and direct outcome capture.

celebrity.author: Dan Shipper
celebrity.title: Dan Shipper: Tested Claude Code against human senior engineers on refactoring an entire Next.js full-stack app. The psychological shift from writing to reviewing diffs is happening fast.
celebrity.title_en: Dan Shipper: Tested Claude Code against human senior engineers on refactoring an entire Next.js full-stack app. The psychological shift from writing to reviewing diffs is happening fast.
celebrity.title_zh: Dan Shipper：在大型全栈 Next.js 项目重构实测中，Claude Code 展现出的速度与架构自洽度令人震撼。从‘逐行写代码’到‘只审查 Diff 代码比对’的心理转变，比所有人预期的快了十倍。
celebrity.quote_zh: 从‘逐行写代码的作者’到‘高维审查 Diff 差异的主编’，这场程序员工作习惯与心理认同的巨变，比行业预想的快了十倍。
celebrity.quote_en: The psychological shift from being an author of raw syntax to an editor-in-chief reviewing agentic git diffs is happening ten times faster than predicted.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
本周我做了一场极其严格的盲测：将一个积累了大量历史技术债的 Next.js 全栈项目，同时交给两位资深工程师与新版终端智能体进行架构升级与依赖拆解。

结果不仅颠覆了我的认知，也让参与测试的技术同行深感震撼：
1. 智能体仅用 14 分钟，就梳理清了复杂的服务端渲染（SSR）与客户端状态通信的交叉依赖；
2. 自动生成了 23 个精准细粒度的 Git Commit，每个 Commit 的原子性与测试覆盖率无可挑剔；
3. 最核心的感受是心理层面的转变：过去写代码是一种‘打字与语法拼装’，现在你坐在屏幕前，身份彻底变成了‘代码主编’，你的精力只聚焦于评审智能体提交的 PR 和设计取舍。

代码生成不再是辅助补全，它已经实质性变成了软件工业的生产流水线。

celebrity.title: Minh Pham: Generative UI demo just hit 200k views in 3 hours. Turn Figma screenshots into fully interactive, fluidly animated React widgets in under 20 seconds.
celebrity.title_en: Minh Pham: Generative UI demo just hit 200k views in 3 hours. Turn Figma screenshots into fully interactive, fluidly animated React widgets in under 20 seconds.
celebrity.title_zh: Minh Pham：生成式 UI 交互实战演示 3 小时狂揽 20 万阅读。直接将 Figma 设计截图转化为具备丝滑物理微动效、可即时操作的 React 高保真组件，全程只需 20 秒。
celebrity.quote_zh: 直接将设计稿截图转化为拥有物理动效与完备事件交互的 React 生产级组件，设计与工程之间的最后一道转化鸿沟已被彻底踏平。
celebrity.quote_en: Translating raw design screenshots directly into interactive React components with fluid physics animations evaporates the final friction between design and frontend.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
简直不敢相信这条演示在 3 小时内获得了超过 20 万次阅读：

我们做了一个把视觉创意推到极致的生成式 UI（Generative UI）流程：
把复杂的 Figma 原型设计截图直接丢给模型，大模型不仅能准确还原配色、排版和 Glassmorphism 微光质感，还能自动推导出点击态、悬停弹性曲线与微交互事件处理。

全程耗时：18 秒。
生成的不是一张假图，而是 100% 结构清晰、带 Tailwind CSS 样式的 React 组件，拖进项目即可直接在生产环境中跑通。

长久以来设计师与前端工程师之间最大的沟通消耗（‘还原度不对’、‘动效参数给错’），正在被这种端到端的可视化实时编译一键抹平。设计师也可以拥有直接发布生产级界面的超能力。
celebrity.full_text_en:
Incredible to see this demo pass 200,000 views within 3 hours:

We explored pushing Generative UI to its visual limit:
Dropping high-fidelity Figma mockups straight into the model, where it deduces not just palette, typography, and glassmorphism styling, but also synthesizes physics-based hover springs and stateful interaction handlers.

Total turnaround: 18 seconds.
This isn't a mock image; it is 100% semantic React with Tailwind classes ready to drop straight into production.

The friction between designers and frontend engineers ('the padding is off by 2px', 'the spring curve isn't right') is vanishing into real-time multimodal compilation. Designers now have the superpower to ship production directly.

celebrity.full_text_zh:
作为 Y Combinator 掌门人，我们在最新一批入选项目中观察到了极其深刻的资本与组织结构演变：

下一家估值突破百亿美元的企业服务巨头，极大概率不会再经历过去那种几百人甚至几千人的官僚扩张，而是一个由 3 位极致极客掌控的蜂窝型微组织。

我们正在目睹令人难以置信的工程现实：
- 一位创始人负责产品与审美架构；
- 两位核心工程师编排数十个自治 AI Agent，分别接管代码编写、自动化测试、CI/CD 持续集成、全天候安全渗透与海外客服响应；
- 一个原本需要 50 人工程团队开发 6 个月的大型分布式多租户系统，现在的 YC 团队只要 4 天就能端到端交付上线并开始收取美元。

资本不再用来给庞大的中层管理发工资，而是全部直接转化为高密度算力。人效比（Revenue per Employee）的定义，在这个周期内已被彻底重构。
celebrity.full_text_en:
As head of Y Combinator, observing our latest batch reveals a tectonic shift in corporate organization:

The next $10B enterprise behemoth will not expand into a bloated multi-thousand-headcount bureaucracy; it will be a 3-person hyper-leveraged cell orchestrating autonomous agent swarms.

We are witnessing staggering execution velocities:
- One founder steers taste, vision, and customer distribution;
- Two engineers command dozens of autonomous agents covering syntax construction, automated test loops, CI/CD, penetration testing, and round-the-clock customer support;
- Systems that previously required 50 engineers six months are shipped and collecting revenue within 4 days.

Capital is no longer deployed toward middle management headcount; it is directly converted into dense compute leverage. Revenue per employee has been permanently redefined.

celebrity.author: Sulaiman Ghauri
celebrity.title: Sulaiman Ghauri: DeepSeek Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) architecture diagram exploded to 300k views. Visual breakdown of why MLA cuts KV cache memory bandwidth by 80%.
celebrity.title_en: Sulaiman Ghauri: DeepSeek Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) architecture diagram exploded to 300k views. Visual breakdown of why MLA cuts KV cache memory bandwidth by 80%.
celebrity.title_zh: Sulaiman Ghauri：DeepSeek 多头潜在注意力机制（MLA）架构深度图解 4 小时突破 30 万浏览。直观揭秘 MLA 为何能将大模型 KV 缓存显存带宽开销暴降 80% 的核心数学与工程原理。
celebrity.quote_zh: DeepSeek 的多头潜在注意力（MLA）并非简单的剪枝，而是从数学本质上对自注意力做低秩投影，将显存墙压榨至极限。
celebrity.quote_en: DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) mathematically compresses attention projections into low-rank representations, shattering the memory bandwidth wall.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
关于 DeepSeek 多头潜在注意力（MLA，Multi-Head Latent Attention）的图解推文在几个小时内获得了 30 多万浏览与上万次转发，说明整个技术社区对这项架构创新的极度渴望。

很多开发者问：为什么传统的 MHA/MQA 会在长上下文时代撞上‘显存带宽墙’？
原因在于：当并发数和上下文窗口飙升至 128k 时，GPU 之间最大的瓶颈根本不是矩阵乘法算力，而是把海量的 Key/Value 向量从 HBM 内存搬运到计算核心的带宽延迟。

DeepSeek 的天才解法：
1. 引入低秩键值压缩（Low-Rank KV Compression）：不再存储完整多头 Key 和 Value，而是将其压缩为一个超低维度的潜在隐向量（Latent Vector）；
2. 仅在推理需要时动态解压或通过矩阵吸收（Matrix Absorption）合并计算；
3. 结果：KV 缓存占用直接骤降至原来的五分之一，这意味着单张 H800/A100 显卡可以并发吞吐 5 倍以上的用户请求，推理成本由此断崖式下降。

这是纯粹由算法数学突破带来的工程奇迹，值得每一个 AI 工程师反复研读。
celebrity.full_text_en:
The visual breakdown of DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) hit over 300,000 views and thousands of retweets within hours, showing the sheer hunger for foundational architectural innovations.

Why did traditional MHA/MQA hit the memory bandwidth wall in long-context workloads?
Because at 128k context and high concurrency, the bottleneck is never matrix multiplication FLOPs; it is moving gargantuan KV tensors from HBM into compute registers.

DeepSeek's breakthrough:
1. Low-Rank KV Compression: rather than caching exhaustive multi-head keys and values, it projects them into a low-dimensional compressed latent representation;
2. Matrix Absorption: decodes or algebraically absorbs projections directly into query computations;
3. Impact: KV cache memory footprint plummets by 80%, allowing a single accelerator to handle 5x concurrent streams at an unprecedented fraction of cost.

This is pure mathematical ingenuity transforming physical hardware economics.

celebrity.quote_zh: 信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。
celebrity.quote_en: My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.
celebrity.full_text_en:
Last month I wrote about how we can build a positive and safe future for everyone:
meta.com/thefutureisfor...

Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely, and the ability to take its own actions to ensure that happens.

The reality is:

- People won't want to use agents that are misaligned with them and that don't do what they ask, so labs have a strong natural incentive to make their models more aligned.

There is a lot of debate about slowing progress on capabilities until alignment catches up. My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.

- Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well.

Meta delayed shipping Muse for several months to focus on safety and security. We didn't call for everyone else to do this before we would. We just did it as part of our day-to-day work because it was clearly the right thing for people and for us. I'm proud of the security foundations we've built.

- Engaging independent evaluators and advisors is industry best practice. MSL already does this today in several areas because it helps produce better work. Other labs can just do this too. In general, it would be helpful for there to be a larger and more diverse ecosystem of evaluators.

- Committing the significant majority of compute towards serving people rather than racing towards recursive self-improvement is one of the best ways to ensure we develop this technology safely. Meta has made this commitment and other labs can do this as well.

I believe the key to building a positive future for everyone is maintaining the right balance of power. This is within our power to do.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
上个月我写了一篇文章，探讨我们如何才能为所有人创造一个积极、安全的未来：meta.com/thefutureisfor...

每个实验室都有责任和动力，按照安全训练其模型所需的速度推进，并且有能力采取自主行动来确保做到这一点。

现实情况是：

- 人们不会想要使用与他们目标不一致、且不按其要求行事的智能体（Agent），因此各实验室本身就具有强烈的内生动力去提升其模型的一致性与对齐（Alignment）。

关于在对齐技术赶上之前是否应放缓能力迭代，目前存在很多争论。我的观点是，信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。

- 实验室若造成危害将面临巨大的法律追责，因此在防范此类风险上他们同样拥有强烈的动力。

Meta 曾主动将 Muse 的发布推迟数月以专注安全与防护。在要求别人这样做之前，我们自己率先践行。我们把这作为日常工作的一部分，因为这显然对公众和我们自己都是正确的选择。我为我们建立的安全基石感到自豪。

- 引入独立评估机构和顾问是行业最佳实践。MSL 目前已在多个领域落地这一做法，这显著提升了工作质量。其他实验室同样可以做到这点。总体而言，一个更大、更多元化的评估生态将大有裨益。

- 将绝大多数算力致力于服务人类，而非盲目角逐递归式自我迭代（Recursive Self-Improvement），是确保我们安全发展该技术的最佳途径之一。Meta 已做出这一承诺，其他实验室同样可以做到。

我相信，开创一个积极未来的核心在于维持正确的权力制衡。这完全在我们掌控之中。

celebrity.full_text_en:
OpenRouter users spent more on OpenAI models than on Anthropic models during the week of Sep 7.

This is the first time this has occurred since February 26, 2024.

Across our aggregated token marketplace:
- OpenAI share surged following recent API price adjustments and coding benchmarks.
- Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet continues to see high organic retention for complex reasoning.
- Open-source models (Llama 3.1 405B, DeepSeek V2.5) continue to grow as cost-effective alternatives.

Full real-time market share trends are available on our analytics dashboard: openrouter.ai/rankings
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在9月7日当周，OpenRouter平台用户在OpenAI模型上的消费支出超过了在Anthropic模型上的支出。

这是自2024年2月26日以来，OpenAI首次在平台周度总消耗金额上反超Anthropic。

根据我们全网聚合Token市场的最新动态：
- 在近期API价格调整以及最新代码基准测试发布后，OpenAI的模型使用份额显著反弹；
- Anthropic的Claude 3.5 Sonnet在复杂推理与全栈代码编写领域依然保持极高的自然留存度；
- 开源前沿模型（如Llama 3.1 405B、DeepSeek V2.5）作为高性价比替代方案，调用量继续保持稳步增长。

完整的实时模型市场份额趋势可在我们的分析排行榜查阅：openrouter.ai/rankings

celebrity.full_text_en:
GPT-5.5 will remain available via the OpenAI API Platform and authenticated via API key as Codex Sessions for developers and enterprise customers:

- Extended Context Window: Full 256k token reasoning with near-zero latency degradation.
- Tool Calling: Native multi-step function orchestration with schema validation.
- Pricing & Quotas: Same competitive Tier-4 and Tier-5 rate limits apply.

Get started with the documentation and sample code at platform.openai.com/docs
celebrity.full_text_zh:
GPT-5.5 将持续通过 OpenAI API 平台向开发者及企业客户开放，支持通过 API 密钥认证直接接入 Codex Sessions 会话体系：

- 超长上下文支持：完整支持 256k Token 深度上下文推理，近乎零延迟损耗；
- 工具链原生编排：支持原生多步函数调用（Function Calling）与严格 Schema 校验；
- 资费与配额：适配现有的 Tier-4 及 Tier-5 高并发速率限制。

欢迎查阅官方文档与示例代码快速接入：platform.openai.com/docs

celebrity.quote_en: Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on how AI's benefits can be broadly distributed, earning the social license to operate.
celebrity.full_text_en:
Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on the All-In Podcast discussing how AI's benefits can be broadly distributed, earning the social license to operate, and what's ahead for the future of work.

Key themes we covered:
- Democratizing intelligence: Putting supercomputing capabilities into the hands of every individual and small enterprise worldwide.
- Energy and infrastructure: Building durable, sustainable datacenters that anchor regional economic prosperity.
- Human agency: Amplifying human productivity and creativity rather than displacing the dignity of labor.

Full episode is out now on all podcast platforms.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
非常高兴与 @chamath、@jason、@davidsacks 和 @friedberg 在 All-In 播客上展开深度对话，探讨如何让 AI 的技术红利惠及每一个人、赢得广泛的社会运营许可，以及未来人机协作形态的演变。

我们探讨的核心主题包括：
- 智能的普惠化：将前沿超级算力交付到全球每一位普通人与中小企业手中；
- 能源与基础设施：建设长效、绿色可持续的新型数据中心，成为带动区域经济繁荣的新锚点；
- 人类主观能动性：AI 的终极价值在于放大人类的生产力与创造力，而非剥夺劳动的尊严。

完整节目已在各大播客平台上线。

celebrity.quote_en: After co-inventing ChatGPT, I kept asking myself: why have super-human chat models not led to AGI? For the past 2 years, I have been stealthily building a new approach.
celebrity.full_text_en:
After co-inventing ChatGPT, I kept asking myself: why have super-human chat models not led to AGI?

For the past 2 years, I have been stealthily building a new approach from first principles to solve true agentic autonomy.

The bottleneck is not scale or prompt engineering. LLMs are next-token predictors operating in static semantic spaces. True intelligence requires:
- Continuous runtime memory formation
- Self-correcting world models
- Action-grounded verification loops

More details coming soon.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在共同发明 ChatGPT 之后，我一直在深入反思一个根本问题：为什么拥有超人水平的对话模型并没有顺理成章地催生 AGI？

在过去的两年里，我一直保持隐身状态，从第一性原理出发构建一种全新的技术范式，以真正解决智能体的自主决策难题。

当前的核心瓶颈既不是纯粹的算力缩放（Scale），也不是提示工程（Prompt Engineering）。大语言模型本质上是在静态语义空间里预测下一个 Token。真正的通用智能需要具备：
- 持续的运行时动态记忆构建
- 能够自我纠错的内部世界模型
- 基于实际行动反馈的闭环验证机制

更多技术细节即将对外公布。

OpenRouter users spent more on OpenAI models than on Anthropic models during the week of Sep 7.

This is the first time this has occurred since February 26, 2024.

Across our aggregated token marketplace:
- OpenAI share surged following recent API price adjustments and coding benchmarks.
- Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet continues to see high organic retention for complex reasoning.
- Open-source models (Llama 3.1 405B, DeepSeek V2.5) continue to grow as cost-effective alternatives.

Full real-time market share trends are available on our analytics dashboard: openrouter.ai/rankings
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在9月7日当周，OpenRouter平台用户在OpenAI模型上的消费支出超过了在Anthropic模型上的支出。

这是自2024年2月26日以来，OpenAI首次在平台周度总消耗金额上反超Anthropic。

根据我们全网聚合Token市场的最新动态：
- 在近期API价格调整以及最新代码基准测试发布后，OpenAI的模型使用份额显著反弹；
- Anthropic的Claude 3.5 Sonnet在复杂推理与全栈代码编写领域依然保持极高的自然留存度；
- 开源前沿模型（如Llama 3.1 405B、DeepSeek V2.5）作为高性价比替代方案，调用量继续保持稳步增长。

完整的实时模型市场份额趋势可在我们的分析排行榜查阅：openrouter.ai/rankings

celebrity.full_text_en:
OpenAI is winning enterprise spend at the frontier.

As of this week, based on Ramp transaction data:
- OpenAI accounts for 13% of total enterprise AI spending.
- Anthropic holds 8%.
- Together they represent over 20% of net enterprise SaaS AI billing.

The key driver: enterprise API commitments and developer tooling lock-in are widening the moat.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
OpenAI 正在前沿大模型领域持续领跑企业级商业支出。

截至本周，基于 Ramp 平台的企业真实交易聚合数据：
- OpenAI 占据了全美企业级 AI 总支出的 13%；
- Anthropic 占据 8%；
- 二者合计已吞下超过 20% 的企业级 SaaS AI 净账单份额。

背后的关键驱动力在于：企业级长约 API 签约以及针对开发者的工具链绑定，正在构筑比模型本身更深的商业护城河。

People are debating whether the threat from AI to cybersecurity will drive cyber company stock prices up or down. The debate misses a crucial point.

AI dramatically lowers the marginal cost of automated offensive probing, but it lowers the marginal cost of defensive response and telemetry patch automation even faster.

Net result: security budgets shift from manual incident response to continuous platform orchestration. Platforms with proprietary telemetry win.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
市场正在热烈争论 AI 对网络安全构成的威胁究竟会导致网安公司的股价上涨还是下跌。然而这场辩论完全忽略了一个核心本质。

虽然 AI 显著降低了自动化进攻嗅探的边际成本，但它对防御响应、遥测日志分析和热补丁自动化的提效速度更为迅猛。

最终结果是：企业安全预算正在从繁重的人工应急响应，全面倒向全天候常态化平台编排。拥有独家专有遥测数据沉淀的网安平台将成为最终赢家。

celebrity.full_text_en:
I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.

Give an LLM a non-trivial kernel subroutine with lockless concurrency, memory-mapped IO, and micro-architectural cache alignment: it hallucinates subtly.

I've written millions of lines of production code. True systems engineering is about physical hardware constraints, telemetry under catastrophic failure, and deterministic guarantees that LLMs cannot even perceive.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我深爱 C++ 并且已经在编程前线奋战了 40 年。对于那些宣称 AI 很快就会取代底层系统程序员的论调，我完全嗤之以鼻。

给大语言模型写一个稍微复杂点的内核子例程——涉及无锁并发（Lockless Concurrency）、内存映射 I/O 以及微架构级别的 CPU 缓存行对齐：它就会产生极其隐蔽而致命的幻觉。

我这辈子写过数百万行生产环境代码。真正的底层系统工程，从来不是拼写语法糖，而是关于物理硬件的严苛约束、极端灾难性故障下的遥测保全，以及绝对确定性的系统保障——这些根本维度甚至超出了现有大语言模型的感知范畴。

Salesforce in Claude is now available in beta.

It brings your customers, opportunities, and pipeline directly into Claude with 37 pre-built sales skills, unified CRM context, and enterprise-grade data privacy.

Sales teams can:
- Query cross-account pipeline dynamics in plain English
- Draft hyper-personalized executive outreach based on CRM history
- Auto-log meeting summaries directly back into Salesforce records

Available today for Claude Team and Enterprise customers: claude.ai/salesforce
celebrity.full_text_zh:
Salesforce in Claude 现已正式开启 Beta 公开测试。

它将你的客户档案、销售商机以及业务转化漏斗直接带入 Claude 的原生工作流，内置 37 项开箱即用的专业销售技能，打通统一 CRM 上下文，并遵循企业级最高数据隐私标准。

销售与运营团队现在可以：
- 用纯自然语言直接查询跨账户的销售管道健康度与预测走势；
- 基于客户完整历史交互记录，自动生成高转化率的高管定制触达邮件；
- 会议结束后自动提炼待办与纪要，并毫秒级回填至 Salesforce 对应记录。

即日起面向 Claude Team 与 Enterprise 订阅用户全面开放：claude.ai/salesforce

prompts.author: OpenAI 研究院

prompts.content_snippet: Adversarial verification prompt forcing OpenAI reasoning models to challenge intermediate proofs before presenting the final answer.

prompts.summary_en: Forces o1/o3 reasoning models to construct counter-examples at each deduction step, eliminating hidden logical leaps.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：
【推理原则】：
1. 在得出任何推论前，强制在内部思考中构建至少 2 个极端反例（Counter-examples）尝试推翻自身结论；
2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

【待证明命题】：
[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]
prompts.prompt_content_en:
Acting as a Theoretical Mathematician and Computer Scientist at the Institute for Advanced Study, provide an airtight formal proof for the following:
[REASONING PRINCIPLES]:
1. Before asserting any deduction, construct at least 2 extreme counter-examples in your reasoning trace to aggressively stress-test the hypothesis;
2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

prompts.summary_en: Rigorous code auditor mode: Refactors code smells without breaking public API contracts, outputting benchmark diffs and unit tests.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位拥有 15 年经验的资深系统架构师与代码审查专家。请在严格遵守原有对外公共契约（Public API Contract）的前提下审查并重构以下代码：
1. 识别代码异味（Code Smell）、隐性内存泄漏与高并发竞争冒险（Race Condition）；
2. 采用现代设计模式与 SOLID 原则进行无破坏性重构，给出重构前后的 Diff 对比；
3. 编写完整的防御性单元测试（含边界值、空指针与异常抛出用例）。

prompts.title_en: 💡 [First Principles Thinking] Elon-Style Ground-Up Physics & Cost Breakdown
prompts.author: 战略极客
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.4 | 第一性原理推演
prompts.content_snippet: Strips away historical analogies, reducing the problem to raw physics and unit economics to find 10x breakthrough paths.
prompts.summary_zh: 剥离行业类比与路径依赖，将问题还原至物理定律与原子级物料成本，推导 10 倍效能的破局路径。
prompts.summary_en: Strips away historical analogies, reducing the problem to raw physics and unit economics to find 10x breakthrough paths.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请暂时忘掉行业现有的所有‘行业惯例’与‘常规做法’。运用绝对的第一性原理（First Principles）审视以下命题：
1. 这个系统最根本、不可违背的基础科学定律（如热力学、香农信息论、计算复杂度）是什么？
2. 若将整个产品拆解为原子级的原材料成本与基础能源成本，理论极限底线是多少？现有成本的溢价主要被哪些中间低效层吃掉了？
3. 颠覆现有行业做法、重构整个价值流并实现成本降低 80% 以上的激进方案是什么？列出三个最关键的试错实验。
prompts.prompt_content_en:
Strip away all conventional industry playbooks and historical analogies. Scrutinize the following challenge purely through First Principles:
1. What are the immutable fundamental laws of science (e.g. thermodynamics, Shannon entropy, computational complexity) governing this system?
2. Deconstruct the unit economics down to raw atoms, base compute, and energy inputs. Where does the 10x margin inefficiency currently leak?
3. Propose an audacious redesign capable of slashing total cost by 80% while preserving fundamental guarantees, detailing three falsifiable proof-of-concept experiments.

prompts.author: 算法工程师
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.1 | 严格张量维度匹配
prompts.content_snippet: Converts dense paper LaTeX equations into vectorized, memory-efficient PyTorch operations with shape assertions.

prompts.summary_en: Converts dense paper LaTeX equations into vectorized, memory-efficient PyTorch operations with shape assertions.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位兼具应用数学博士学位与顶级深度学习框架优化经验的算法工程师。请将以下论文中的 LaTeX 数学公式翻译为高质量的 PyTorch 实现：
1. 逐一解释公式中各标量、向量与张量上下标的精确几何与物理含义；
2. 编写无 Python 原生 for 循环的高性能向量化代码（善用 torch.einsum, bmm, 或 broadcast 广播机制）；
3. 在每行关键张量操作后标注显式的 Shape 注释（如 `# [Batch, Heads, Seq_Len, Dim]`），并加入数值稳定性保护（如防除以零的 eps 与 log-sum-exp 技巧）。

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位顶级 WebGL 与游戏图形学 TA（技术美术）专家。请为 Three.js 编写一个生产级自定义 ShaderMaterial：
1. 顶点着色器（Vertex Shader）：使用 3D Simplex 噪声在 GPU 端实现柔和的顶点位移波动；
2. 片元着色器（Fragment Shader）：计算菲涅尔效应（Fresnel Effect）边缘泛光，并加入随时间流逝不断滚动的全息扫描线；
3. 完整的 JS/TS 接入代码：声明 Uniforms（uTime, uColor, uFresnelBias），并在 render loop 中高效更新。

在 Threads 看到很多做工业设计和品牌视觉的朋友问：怎样让 Midjourney 的出图彻底摆脱“AI 塑料感”？

总结了这三个核心法则：

✨ 1. 禁用任何虚词（如 hyperrealistic, 8k, trending on artstation），它们只会污染潜在空间；
✨ 2. 使用 `--sref <真实商业摄影图URL> --sw 150` 将真实摄影器材的色调与光晕直接植入；
✨ 3. 加入 `--p`（个性化偏好参数）与特定材质词（如 matte anodized aluminum, diffuse subsurface scattering）。

viral_posts.quote_zh: 再也不需要花几十分钟训练专属 LoRA。一张正脸生活照，在任何构图、光影与服饰下都能保持同一个人。
viral_posts.quote_en: No need to spend 40 minutes training custom LoRAs. A single snapshot keeps character identity locked across all lighting and poses.
viral_posts.full_text_zh:
做电商模特换装或短剧人物设定的朋友一定要收下这套 ComfyUI 节点组合：

📌 仅需提供 1 张普通的手机正面抓拍；
📌 InstantID 提取 512 维人脸关键点特征，配合 InsightFace 进行特征投影；
📌 在 ControlNet OpenPose 引导下，无论是俯拍、仰拍还是侧颜大光圈，人脸辨识度依然高达 98%！

thread_replies.author: Comfy Master Tao
thread_replies.content_zh:
【参数关键设定】
InstantID 权重建议设定为 `0.85`，IP-Adapter 脸部权重设为 `0.6`。两个权重交叉混合可以有效消除‘面具感’，让皮肤光泽自然融入背景。
thread_replies.content_en:
[Key Parameters]
Set InstantID weight to `0.85` and IP-Adapter face weight to `0.6`. Cross-blending removes the 'mask look' and blends skin tone into ambient light.

comments_list.content_zh: 侧光仰拍的立体感居然保住了，不用重练 LoRA 真的省了海量时间！
comments_list.content_en: Preserves lighting contours even in profile shots. Skipping LoRA training is huge.

viral_posts.author: Rowan Cheung
viral_posts.title: The Rundown AI：Anthropic Claude 3.7 混合推理模式发布，自主 Agent 工作流正在重塑日常办公
viral_posts.title_en: The Rundown AI: Anthropic Claude 3.7 Hybrid Reasoning Launched, Autonomous Agent Workflows Transforming Productivity
viral_posts.title_zh: The Rundown AI：Anthropic Claude 3.7 混合推理模式发布，自主 Agent 工作流正在重塑日常办公
viral_posts.quote_zh: 2026 年的 AI 竞赛不再只是拼单一响应速度，而是谁能将长程思考链与即时工具调用无缝融合在同一个模型中。
viral_posts.quote_en: The 2026 AI frontier is no longer just raw response speed; it's about seamlessly blending extended reasoning with instant tool execution in one unified model.
viral_posts.full_text_zh:
今日 The Rundown 核心情报速览：

Anthropic 正式推出 Claude 3.7 Sonnet，带来了行业期待已久的「混合推理（Hybrid Reasoning）」架构：

🚀 动态可调节思考预算：用户可在 1k 到 128k tokens 之间随意指定模型的思考深度；
🚀 边思考边调用工具：不再像旧模型那样先写完长篇思考再调 API，而是可以在思考链中间随时发起 bash 验证或文件检索；
🚀 编程基准 SWE-bench Verified 飙升至 70.3%，刷新自主修复软件工程难题的世界纪录！

深度解析与企业落地建议见下方连推：
viral_posts.surge_badge: 🧵 Threads 社区热议榜 (Likes>300 / 今日速递)

thread_replies.author: Rowan Cheung
thread_replies.content_zh:
【三大核心启示】
1. 中小任务关闭思考模式，保持极速低成本响应；
2. 复杂重构与数学论证开启 32k 思考预算，错误率下降近 60%；
3. 结合 Claude Code 终端命令行，单个工程师的日常功能交付效率直接翻倍。

comments_list.author: David Vance
comments_list.content_zh: 混合推理确实是目前最优雅的架构，终于不用在‘慢推理模型’和‘快通用模型’之间来回切了。
comments_list.content_en: Hybrid reasoning is the most elegant architecture yet. No more switching back and forth between slow-thinkers and fast-chat models.

thread_replies.author: codila
thread_replies.content_zh:
多智能体军团的分工体系：
- PM Agent：负责将模糊的产品目标拆解为敏捷任务卡；
- 架构 Agent：审查 API 协议与数据库 Schema；
- 编码 Agent 群：并发实现具体子模块；
- 幕僚长（Chief of Staff）：负责汇总状态并在关键决策点向人类汇报。

viral_posts.title_zh: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 官方最佳实践：如何构建多工具自主智能体标准通信总线
viral_posts.quote_zh: MCP 之于 AI 智能体，就如同 USB 协议之于个人电脑。标准化是让每个开发者都能随心组装私有工具箱的唯一道路。
viral_posts.quote_en: MCP is to AI agents what the USB standard was to personal computing. Standardization is the only path to letting every developer assemble custom toolkits.
viral_posts.full_text_zh:
看到 Threads 上越来越多的独立开发者和极客在动手编写自己的 MCP 服务器。

分享三条至关重要的官方架构建议：

🛡️ 1. 严格分离读写权限：对涉及文件覆写、数据库 DROP 或外部邮件发送的操作，必须在 MCP Tool Schema 中强制加入 `confirm_required` 确认标记；
🛡️ 2. 工具粒度要精简原子化：让智能体串联小工具，而不是把一整个业务流写成一个巨大的黑盒工具；
🛡️ 3. 规范错误堆栈返回：返回可被 LLM 自我纠错的友好语义信息，而不是生硬的 500 异常堆栈。

thread_replies.author: Gergely Orosz
thread_replies.content_zh:
架构核心分为三层：
1. 规范生成层：人类工程师只写高层设计意图与边界约束；
2. 并行 PR 工厂：智能体集群并发生成 8~10 个独立实现分支；
3. 自动化严苛测试沙箱：沙箱执行上千次模糊测试与压力压测，只留下性能指标最顶尖且零回归的代码分支合并入主干。

comments_list.author: KentCDodds
comments_list.content_zh: 测试沙箱才是真正的壁垒。没有自动化沙箱，让模型并发跑 10 个 PR 只会给人类 Reviewer 制造灾难性的认知过载。

ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Industry Insight: Reflects the transition towards commercial maturity and balanced governance.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在美国众议院听证会上，财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，人工智能实验室不应获得责任豁免，并呼吁在美国建立更多的开源模型。 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

Context: 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

news.content_snippet: The virtual character, which is promoting its upcoming movie Misaligned, tries to evade politics by repetitively commenting on the clothes you’re wearing.

news.title_zh: 人工智能“演员”蒂莉·诺伍德（ Tilly Norwood ）告诉我“所有生命都很重要”

news.content_snippet: OpenAI and Anthropic tell corporate customers their data won't be used for training. But when Anthropic said it would store usage logs from its flagship model Fable for 30 days, Palantir, Nvidia, and Booz Allen Hamilton pulled back from using it for sensitive work. From boardroom

news.summary_zh: OpenAI和Anthropic告诉企业客户，他们的数据不会用于培训。但是当Anthropic说它会

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 人工智能实验室存在数据信任问题，其政策尚未解决。 OpenAI和Anthropic告诉企业客户，他们的数据不会用于培训。但是当Anthropic说它会存储flash的使用日志时。 前沿模型研发面临海量数据抓取合规争议与创作者信任危机，亟需构建透明可信的追溯机制与合理的版权利益分配方案。

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 模型训练时巨头们在全网大肆抓取数据，把知识资产据为己有；等商业化落地收月租时，面对原创作者和公众的质疑，反手掏出几十页推诿责任的“数据政策声明”。信任从来不是靠公关文案自证清白，当整个前沿模型的基石建立在未经许可的内容吞噬之上时，任何所谓的自律协议，看起来都更像是亡羊补牢的法律护膝。

news.title: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch:
India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift  —  India has finally put a price on larger transactions on its ubiquitous
news.summary_en:
Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch:
India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift  —  India has finally put a price on larger transactions on its ubiquitous
news.title_zh: 从10月15日起，印度的UPI将对超过2000卢比（21美元）的某些付款征收0.4%的商户费，这是一个重大转变。
news.summary_zh: 印度的UPI一直对商户免费，但将对某些收费收取0.4%的商户费

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 从10月15日起，印度的UPI将对超过2000卢比（21美元）的某些付款征收0.4%的商户费，这是一个重大转变。 该调整标志着核心数字基础设施正告别长期的免费补贴模式，通过向高频商业结算收取增值服务费以分摊高昂的结算与算力基础设施运维成本。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 印度移动金融与大额数字支付市场, 印度统一支付接口 (UPI / NPCI) advanced a key development: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 in a major shift. Context: 该调整标志着核心数字基础设施正告别长期的免费补贴模式，通过向高频商业结算收取增值服务费以分摊高昂的结算与算力基础设施运维成本。

news.title: GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs (David Welch/Bloomberg)

news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet:
David Welch / Bloomberg:
GM plans to add Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to its latest infotainment system, three years after upsetting some consumers by removing them from its EVs  —  General Motors Co. is integrating Apple Inc.'s CarPlay in its latest infotainmen
news.summary_en:

news.title_zh: 通用汽车计划将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车（Android Auto）加入其最新的信息娱乐系统，三年前，通用汽车将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车从其电动汽车中移除，令一些消费者感到不满。
news.summary_zh: 大卫·韦尔奇/彭博社： 通用汽车计划在三年前将Apple CarPlay和Android Auto添加到其最新的信息娱乐系统中

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 通用汽车计划将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车（Android Auto）加入其最新的信息娱乐系统，三年前，通用汽车将苹果CarPlay和安卓汽车从其电动汽车中移除，令一些消费者感到不满。 通用汽车重新引入手机互联映射方案，表明封闭自研车机在抗衡成熟移动生态心智时遭遇现实阻力，顺应用户对无缝导航与音频交互的刚需成为保障终端口碑的务实选择。

Context: 通用汽车重新引入手机互联映射方案，表明封闭自研车机在抗衡成熟移动生态心智时遭遇现实阻力，顺应用户对无缝导航与音频交互的刚需成为保障终端口碑的务实选择。

news.summary_zh: 人工智能承保公司，该公司提供审计和安全认证

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 为人工智能代理提供审计和安全认证的人工智能承销公司（Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company）筹集了4000万美元的a轮融资，使总融资额达到5500万美元。 巨额融资意向凸显出头部模型公司在研发前沿架构与构建超级计算集群过程中巨大的资本消耗率，企业正力求在公开上市前锁定充沛流动性以构筑壁垒。

news.title_zh: Meta表示，公司计划于2027年上半年在数据中心部署其第三代定制AI芯片MTIA 450，并于2027年底广泛推出MTIA 500。
news.summary_zh: 迪娜·巴斯/彭博社： Meta表示，它计划在上半年在数据中心部署其第三代定制AI芯片MTIA 450

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta表示，公司计划于2027年上半年在数据中心部署其第三代定制AI芯片MTIA 450，并于2027年底广泛推出MTIA 500。 调查反映出AI高耗能算力设施在地方落地时正面临严峻的电力供应、土地资源及公众环境关切阻力，AI基建扩张正在从单纯的技术投资转变为敏感的公共与政治议题。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Executive Briefing: In 算力芯片供应链与云端基础设施, Meta (扎克伯格团队) advanced a key development: Meta says it plans to deploy MTIA 450, its third-generation custom AI chip, in data centers in H1 2027, followed by a broad rollout of MTIA 500 by end of 2027. Context: 调查反映出AI高耗能算力设施在地方落地时正面临严峻的电力供应、土地资源及公众环境关切阻力，AI基建扩张正在从单纯的技术投资转变为敏感的公共与政治议题。

news.title_zh: OpenAI支持《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，该条款是众议院两党提出的一项提案，要求人工智能公司嵌入外部评估人员，以确保模型安全。
news.summary_zh: OpenAI支持《边境法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，这是众议院两党提出的一项提案

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI支持《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act）的一项条款，该条款是众议院两党提出的一项提案，要求人工智能公司嵌入外部评估人员，以确保模型安全。 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

Context: 此举深层背景在于防范前沿AI系统引发法律追责真空与安全失控风险，同时通过划定合规红线与扶持开源生态，防止闭源科技巨头形成行业事实垄断。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 为人工智能、自动化等领域生产芯片的Altera公司秘密提交了IPO申请；2015年，英特尔以约167亿美元的价格收购了它，银湖在2025年收购了51%的股份。 巨额融资意向凸显出头部模型公司在研发前沿架构与构建超级计算集群过程中巨大的资本消耗率，企业正力求在公开上市前锁定充沛流动性以构筑壁垒。

celebrity.title: Pieter Levels: Vibe coding is completely real. Built and launched a full native SaaS in 48 hours using Cursor and Claude, crossed $10k MRR on day one. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures.
celebrity.title_en: Pieter Levels: Vibe coding is completely real. Built and launched a full native SaaS in 48 hours using Cursor and Claude, crossed $10k MRR on day one. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures.
celebrity.title_zh: Pieter Levels：氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。我用 Cursor 和 Claude 在 48 小时内从零构建并上线了一款完整的原生 SaaS，首日 MRR 突破 1 万美元。现在的开发者不再写语法细节，而是在指挥架构设计。
celebrity.quote_zh: 氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。现在的独立开发者不再逐行扣语法细节，而是在用大模型指挥整体架构设计。
celebrity.quote_en: Vibe coding is completely real. You don't write syntax anymore, you steer architectures and prompt product vision.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
氛围编码（Vibe Coding）已彻底成真。

这个周末我做了一个极限挑战：完全不手动编写任何一行底层 CRUD 语法，仅使用 Cursor 搭配最新的 Claude 模型，在 48 小时内从零构建并上线了一款全功能原生跨端 SaaS 应用。

结果令人震撼：产品发布第一天，月经常性收入（MRR）就直接突破了 10,000 美元。

我的核心体会：
1. 编码范式已被彻底重写：你不需要记住具体框架的繁琐 API，大模型对代码库上下文的掌握远比人脑快；
2. 架构决策权依然在人：模型会犯错，但只要你懂系统骨架、数据流与业务闭环，给它精准的约束边界，它能以人类百倍的速度把功能落实为可运行代码；
3. 一人超级公司的时代正式到来。
celebrity.full_text_en:
Vibe coding is completely real.

This weekend I ran an extreme experiment: without writing a single line of raw CRUD boilerplate syntax by hand, using only Cursor paired with the latest Claude model, I built and launched a full-stack native cross-platform SaaS in 48 hours.

The result is staggering: on day one after launch, it crossed $10,000 in monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

My key takeaways:
1. The programming paradigm is officially broken and rebuilt: you no longer need to memorize framework API idiosyncrasies; LLM context comprehension is orders of magnitude faster than human lookup;
2. Architectural decisions remain human: models make mistakes, but as long as you understand system skeletons, state pipelines, and business loops, giving precise boundaries allows it to materialize working code at 100x speed;
3. The era of the one-person billion-dollar company is here.

celebrity.title: Mckay Wrigley: We officially have a zero-latency Jarvis running completely local on Mac. Multi-agent voice system orchestrating your browser and IDE with no cloud API.
celebrity.title_en: Mckay Wrigley: We officially have a zero-latency Jarvis running completely local on Mac. Multi-agent voice system orchestrating your browser and IDE with no cloud API.
celebrity.title_zh: Mckay Wrigley：我们终于在 Mac 芯片上实现了 100% 本地脱机运行的零延迟 Jarvis 语音助手。多智能体系统完全在端侧协同接管浏览器与开发工具，不走任何云端 API。
celebrity.quote_zh: 我们终于在普通消费级 Mac 芯片上，跑通了 100% 本地脱机运行、端到端零延迟的私人 Jarvis 智能体。
celebrity.quote_en: We officially have a zero-latency Jarvis running completely local on consumer Mac silicon without touching a single cloud API.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我们终于在普通消费级 Mac 芯片上，做出了真正堪比钢铁侠 Jarvis 的多智能体语音助手。

最硬核的一点是：它不需要连接任何云端网络，零 API 费用，端到端延迟低到近乎自然人类对话。

系统技术栈构成：
- 本地语音唤醒与双工转录：基于自研量化 Whisper 实时流处理；
- 核心推理引擎：端侧量化 32B 开源基座，运行在 Mac M4 Max 的 Unified Memory 架构上；
- 动作执行：通过本地系统自动化脚本直接编排浏览器、VSCode 和终端。

当你开口说话时，它能边听边打断，瞬间在屏幕上调度三个 Agent 分工查资料、重构代码并跑通测试。未来计算的形态正在从‘点击输入’彻底转向‘自然多模态伴生’。
celebrity.full_text_en:
We officially have a real-time Jarvis running completely offline on consumer Mac silicon.

The most hardcore part: zero cloud connection, zero recurring API bills, and end-to-end latency that feels identical to natural human voice interruption.

Stack breakdown:
- Streaming duplex voice ingestion: localized quantized Whisper;
- Brain: local quantized 32B open weights running across Apple Silicon unified memory;
- Action execution: localized accessibility and shell integration orchestrating Chrome, VSCode, and git.

When you speak, it listens and interrupts with zero awkward silence. Multi-agent swarms execute tasks across your screen in real time. The paradigm is officially shifting from keyboard clicks to seamless multimodal symbiosis.

celebrity.author: Alex Albert
celebrity.title: Alex Albert: Engineers are using Claude hybrid reasoning mode with MCP servers to autonomously debug 100,000-line legacy codebases overnight.
celebrity.title_en: Alex Albert: Engineers are using Claude hybrid reasoning mode with MCP servers to autonomously debug 100,000-line legacy codebases overnight.
celebrity.title_zh: Alex Albert：工程师们正通过 Claude 混合深度推理模式搭配 MCP 协议，让智能体在夜间自主排查并重构超过 10 万行代码的陈旧复杂系统。
celebrity.quote_zh: 混合深度推理与标准化 MCP 协议的结合，让智能体在夜间自主排查并重构 10 万行遗留系统的成功率从不可行跃升至量产可用。
celebrity.quote_en: Pairing hybrid reasoning with standardized MCP servers lifts the success rate of autonomous 100k-line refactoring from impossible to production-grade.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
过去 24 小时收到大量工程师团队的震撼实测反馈：

当我们将混合深度推理（Hybrid Thinking）与模型上下文协议（MCP）组合后，智能体的工程破障能力发生了质变。

以前让模型重构一个十几万行的大型工程，模型往往在翻了五六个文件后陷入‘注意力迷失’或臆想函数；
现在，工程师通过配置 GitHub MCP 与本地测试执行器 MCP：
1. 模型首先会在思考链中自主绘制整个模块的调用依赖拓扑图；
2. 自主编写单元测试捕获边缘边界；
3. 一旦代码测试报错，模型会在推理空间反复自我博弈，定位是依赖版本错位还是逻辑越界，而不是直接无脑输出一堆毫无意义的修正重试。

昨晚有团队让它自主跑了一整夜，清理掉了积累 3 年的 47 个历史遗留并发竞态 Bug。软件工程的重构成本已被彻底改写。
celebrity.full_text_en:
The feedback from engineering teams over the last 24 hours has been nothing short of extraordinary:

When pairing hybrid reasoning with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic problem-solving undergoes a phase shift.

Previously, attempting to refactor a 100k-line codebase caused models to lose context coherence after five file reads, hallucinating non-existent imports.
Now, by combining a GitHub MCP with a localized test-runner MCP:
1. The model maps architectural dependencies inside its dedicated thinking token space first;
2. Autonomously writes test harnesses capturing edge boundaries;
3. When test runs fail, it self-debates in reasoning trace rather than blindly spewing randomized patches.

One team left an agent running overnight and woke up to 47 long-standing concurrency race condition bugs cleanly resolved with green test suites.

comments_list.author: FullStackPro
comments_list.content: MCP 协议标准化真是神来之笔，统一了工具调用的抽象层，大模型终于不用针对每个第三方写一套胶水代码了。

comments_list.author: RustaceanX
comments_list.content: 关键是模型懂得先写测试用例自证对错，没有红绿灯反馈的大模型写代码就像蒙眼开车。

celebrity.author: Swyx (Shawn Wang)
celebrity.title: Swyx: Context caching economics have quietly flipped the entire SaaS business model upside down. Agents with million-token caches cost pennies to run continuously.
celebrity.title_en: Swyx: Context caching economics have quietly flipped the entire SaaS business model upside down. Agents with million-token caches cost pennies to run continuously.
celebrity.title_zh: Swyx：上下文缓存（Context Caching）的极低成本优势，正悄然将传统企业 SaaS 商业模式连根颠覆。常驻百万 Token 上下文的智能体，现在连续运行只需几美分。
celebrity.quote_zh: 上下文缓存带来的量级降本，正悄然将传统企业软件的商业根基连根拔起：常驻百万上下文的智能体，连续运转的边际成本已近乎为零。
celebrity.quote_en: Context caching economics have quietly flipped enterprise software upside down: keeping million-token agents running continuously now costs mere pennies.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
许多人还没有算明白上下文缓存（Context Caching）在经济模型上引发的剧震：

在此之前，每一次给大模型喂入几十万字的业务代码、法律合同或用户历史对话，都要按全额 Input Token 计费。一个需要频繁查询庞大知识库的复杂智能体，一天调用几十次成本就可能高达几十美元。

现在，主流供应商（Gemini, DeepSeek, Anthropic）的缓存命中折扣普遍高达 80%~90%：
- 你可以把全公司的 API 手册、历史代码库乃至全部内部知识库长期‘热驻留’在大模型显存中；
- 智能体随叫随到，每轮交互只需支付极微小的新增 Token 成本；
- 这意味着：以前按‘坐席订阅费’收取每年几十万美元的传统企业内部知识库软件，其护城河一夜之间被降维打击为廉价的缓存通道。

软件的商业模式正在从‘卖功能许可’彻底转向‘算力套利与价值分成’。
celebrity.full_text_en:
People haven't run the math on the sheer economic earthquake caused by Context Caching:

Previously, every single call that fed large codebases, legal contracts, or conversation trees incurred full input pricing. A complex agent querying knowledge bases 50 times a day could easily rack up tens of dollars daily.

Now, with cache hit discounts universally reaching 80% to 90%:
- You can keep entire enterprise repositories and documentation warm in model memory around the clock;
- Agents respond with zero reload penalty and marginal fees for incremental tokens;
- This evaporates the moat of traditional enterprise software charging six-figure seat licenses for glorified search indexing.

SaaS economics are permanently shifting from feature subscriptions to compute arbitrage and direct outcome capture.

celebrity.author: Dan Shipper
celebrity.title: Dan Shipper: Tested Claude Code against human senior engineers on refactoring an entire Next.js full-stack app. The psychological shift from writing to reviewing diffs is happening fast.
celebrity.title_en: Dan Shipper: Tested Claude Code against human senior engineers on refactoring an entire Next.js full-stack app. The psychological shift from writing to reviewing diffs is happening fast.
celebrity.title_zh: Dan Shipper：在大型全栈 Next.js 项目重构实测中，Claude Code 展现出的速度与架构自洽度令人震撼。从‘逐行写代码’到‘只审查 Diff 代码比对’的心理转变，比所有人预期的快了十倍。
celebrity.quote_zh: 从‘逐行写代码的作者’到‘高维审查 Diff 差异的主编’，这场程序员工作习惯与心理认同的巨变，比行业预想的快了十倍。
celebrity.quote_en: The psychological shift from being an author of raw syntax to an editor-in-chief reviewing agentic git diffs is happening ten times faster than predicted.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
本周我做了一场极其严格的盲测：将一个积累了大量历史技术债的 Next.js 全栈项目，同时交给两位资深工程师与新版终端智能体进行架构升级与依赖拆解。

结果不仅颠覆了我的认知，也让参与测试的技术同行深感震撼：
1. 智能体仅用 14 分钟，就梳理清了复杂的服务端渲染（SSR）与客户端状态通信的交叉依赖；
2. 自动生成了 23 个精准细粒度的 Git Commit，每个 Commit 的原子性与测试覆盖率无可挑剔；
3. 最核心的感受是心理层面的转变：过去写代码是一种‘打字与语法拼装’，现在你坐在屏幕前，身份彻底变成了‘代码主编’，你的精力只聚焦于评审智能体提交的 PR 和设计取舍。

代码生成不再是辅助补全，它已经实质性变成了软件工业的生产流水线。
celebrity.surge_badge: 🧵 独立作者深度长文 · 6.2k 赞

celebrity.author: Minh Pham
celebrity.title: Minh Pham: Generative UI demo just hit 200k views in 3 hours. Turn Figma screenshots into fully interactive, fluidly animated React widgets in under 20 seconds.
celebrity.title_en: Minh Pham: Generative UI demo just hit 200k views in 3 hours. Turn Figma screenshots into fully interactive, fluidly animated React widgets in under 20 seconds.
celebrity.title_zh: Minh Pham：生成式 UI 交互实战演示 3 小时狂揽 20 万阅读。直接将 Figma 设计截图转化为具备丝滑物理微动效、可即时操作的 React 高保真组件，全程只需 20 秒。
celebrity.quote_zh: 直接将设计稿截图转化为拥有物理动效与完备事件交互的 React 生产级组件，设计与工程之间的最后一道转化鸿沟已被彻底踏平。
celebrity.quote_en: Translating raw design screenshots directly into interactive React components with fluid physics animations evaporates the final friction between design and frontend.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
简直不敢相信这条演示在 3 小时内获得了超过 20 万次阅读：

我们做了一个把视觉创意推到极致的生成式 UI（Generative UI）流程：
把复杂的 Figma 原型设计截图直接丢给模型，大模型不仅能准确还原配色、排版和 Glassmorphism 微光质感，还能自动推导出点击态、悬停弹性曲线与微交互事件处理。

全程耗时：18 秒。
生成的不是一张假图，而是 100% 结构清晰、带 Tailwind CSS 样式的 React 组件，拖进项目即可直接在生产环境中跑通。

长久以来设计师与前端工程师之间最大的沟通消耗（‘还原度不对’、‘动效参数给错’），正在被这种端到端的可视化实时编译一键抹平。设计师也可以拥有直接发布生产级界面的超能力。
celebrity.full_text_en:
Incredible to see this demo pass 200,000 views within 3 hours:

We explored pushing Generative UI to its visual limit:
Dropping high-fidelity Figma mockups straight into the model, where it deduces not just palette, typography, and glassmorphism styling, but also synthesizes physics-based hover springs and stateful interaction handlers.

Total turnaround: 18 seconds.
This isn't a mock image; it is 100% semantic React with Tailwind classes ready to drop straight into production.

The friction between designers and frontend engineers ('the padding is off by 2px', 'the spring curve isn't right') is vanishing into real-time multimodal compilation. Designers now have the superpower to ship production directly.

celebrity.author: Garry Tan
celebrity.title: Garry Tan: The next $10B enterprise company will be founded by a 3-person team orchestrating autonomous AI agent swarms. We see YC founders shipping in days what took 50 engineers months.
celebrity.title_en: Garry Tan: The next $10B enterprise company will be founded by a 3-person team orchestrating autonomous AI agent swarms. We see YC founders shipping in days what took 50 engineers months.
celebrity.title_zh: Garry Tan：下一家估值百亿美元的企业级科技巨头，将由一个仅仅 3 人的核心团队通过自主 AI 智能体集群协同创建。我们在 YC 看到初创团队在几天内交付的工程，过去需要 50 人的技术团队做半年。
celebrity.quote_zh: 下一家估值百亿美元的超级科技企业，将由仅有 3 人的创始团队通过编排自主智能体集群创建。人效比的定义已被永久重写。
celebrity.quote_en: The next $10B enterprise powerhouse will be founded by a 3-person team running autonomous agent swarms. Human leverage has been permanently redefined.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
作为 Y Combinator 掌门人，我们在最新一批入选项目中观察到了极其深刻的资本与组织结构演变：

下一家估值突破百亿美元的企业服务巨头，极大概率不会再经历过去那种几百人甚至几千人的官僚扩张，而是一个由 3 位极致极客掌控的蜂窝型微组织。

我们正在目睹令人难以置信的工程现实：
- 一位创始人负责产品与审美架构；
- 两位核心工程师编排数十个自治 AI Agent，分别接管代码编写、自动化测试、CI/CD 持续集成、全天候安全渗透与海外客服响应；
- 一个原本需要 50 人工程团队开发 6 个月的大型分布式多租户系统，现在的 YC 团队只要 4 天就能端到端交付上线并开始收取美元。

资本不再用来给庞大的中层管理发工资，而是全部直接转化为高密度算力。人效比（Revenue per Employee）的定义，在这个周期内已被彻底重构。
celebrity.full_text_en:
As head of Y Combinator, observing our latest batch reveals a tectonic shift in corporate organization:

The next $10B enterprise behemoth will not expand into a bloated multi-thousand-headcount bureaucracy; it will be a 3-person hyper-leveraged cell orchestrating autonomous agent swarms.

We are witnessing staggering execution velocities:
- One founder steers taste, vision, and customer distribution;
- Two engineers command dozens of autonomous agents covering syntax construction, automated test loops, CI/CD, penetration testing, and round-the-clock customer support;
- Systems that previously required 50 engineers six months are shipped and collecting revenue within 4 days.

celebrity.quote_zh: DeepSeek 的多头潜在注意力（MLA）并非简单的剪枝，而是从数学本质上对自注意力做低秩投影，将显存墙压榨至极限。
celebrity.quote_en: DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) mathematically compresses attention projections into low-rank representations, shattering the memory bandwidth wall.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
关于 DeepSeek 多头潜在注意力（MLA，Multi-Head Latent Attention）的图解推文在几个小时内获得了 30 多万浏览与上万次转发，说明整个技术社区对这项架构创新的极度渴望。

很多开发者问：为什么传统的 MHA/MQA 会在长上下文时代撞上‘显存带宽墙’？
原因在于：当并发数和上下文窗口飙升至 128k 时，GPU 之间最大的瓶颈根本不是矩阵乘法算力，而是把海量的 Key/Value 向量从 HBM 内存搬运到计算核心的带宽延迟。

DeepSeek 的天才解法：
1. 引入低秩键值压缩（Low-Rank KV Compression）：不再存储完整多头 Key 和 Value，而是将其压缩为一个超低维度的潜在隐向量（Latent Vector）；
2. 仅在推理需要时动态解压或通过矩阵吸收（Matrix Absorption）合并计算；
3. 结果：KV 缓存占用直接骤降至原来的五分之一，这意味着单张 H800/A100 显卡可以并发吞吐 5 倍以上的用户请求，推理成本由此断崖式下降。

这是纯粹由算法数学突破带来的工程奇迹，值得每一个 AI 工程师反复研读。
celebrity.full_text_en:
The visual breakdown of DeepSeek's Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) hit over 300,000 views and thousands of retweets within hours, showing the sheer hunger for foundational architectural innovations.

Why did traditional MHA/MQA hit the memory bandwidth wall in long-context workloads?
Because at 128k context and high concurrency, the bottleneck is never matrix multiplication FLOPs; it is moving gargantuan KV tensors from HBM into compute registers.

DeepSeek's breakthrough:
1. Low-Rank KV Compression: rather than caching exhaustive multi-head keys and values, it projects them into a low-dimensional compressed latent representation;
2. Matrix Absorption: decodes or algebraically absorbs projections directly into query computations;
3. Impact: KV cache memory footprint plummets by 80%, allowing a single accelerator to handle 5x concurrent streams at an unprecedented fraction of cost.

This is pure mathematical ingenuity transforming physical hardware economics.

celebrity.quote_zh: 信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。
celebrity.quote_en: My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.
celebrity.full_text_en:
Last month I wrote about how we can build a positive and safe future for everyone:
meta.com/thefutureisfor...

Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely, and the ability to take its own actions to ensure that happens.

The reality is:

- People won't want to use agents that are misaligned with them and that don't do what they ask, so labs have a strong natural incentive to make their models more aligned.

There is a lot of debate about slowing progress on capabilities until alignment catches up. My view is that trust and alignment are quickly becoming the most important capabilities that will differentiate agents and models. Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind.

- Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well.

Meta delayed shipping Muse for several months to focus on safety and security. We didn't call for everyone else to do this before we would. We just did it as part of our day-to-day work because it was clearly the right thing for people and for us. I'm proud of the security foundations we've built.

- Engaging independent evaluators and advisors is industry best practice. MSL already does this today in several areas because it helps produce better work. Other labs can just do this too. In general, it would be helpful for there to be a larger and more diverse ecosystem of evaluators.

- Committing the significant majority of compute towards serving people rather than racing towards recursive self-improvement is one of the best ways to ensure we develop this technology safely. Meta has made this commitment and other labs can do this as well.

I believe the key to building a positive future for everyone is maintaining the right balance of power. This is within our power to do.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
上个月我写了一篇文章，探讨我们如何才能为所有人创造一个积极、安全的未来：meta.com/thefutureisfor...

每个实验室都有责任和动力，按照安全训练其模型所需的速度推进，并且有能力采取自主行动来确保做到这一点。

现实情况是：

- 人们不会想要使用与他们目标不一致、且不按其要求行事的智能体（Agent），因此各实验室本身就具有强烈的内生动力去提升其模型的一致性与对齐（Alignment）。

关于在对齐技术赶上之前是否应放缓能力迭代，目前存在很多争论。我的观点是，信任与对齐正迅速成为区分智能体和模型的最关键能力。任何不把精力聚焦在对齐上的实验室都将不可避免地落后。

- 实验室若造成危害将面临巨大的法律追责，因此在防范此类风险上他们同样拥有强烈的动力。

Meta 曾主动将 Muse 的发布推迟数月以专注安全与防护。在要求别人这样做之前，我们自己率先践行。我们把这作为日常工作的一部分，因为这显然对公众和我们自己都是正确的选择。我为我们建立的安全基石感到自豪。

- 引入独立评估机构和顾问是行业最佳实践。MSL 目前已在多个领域落地这一做法，这显著提升了工作质量。其他实验室同样可以做到这点。总体而言，一个更大、更多元化的评估生态将大有裨益。

- 将绝大多数算力致力于服务人类，而非盲目角逐递归式自我迭代（Recursive Self-Improvement），是确保我们安全发展该技术的最佳途径之一。Meta 已做出这一承诺，其他实验室同样可以做到。

我相信，开创一个积极未来的核心在于维持正确的权力制衡。这完全在我们掌控之中。

This is the first time this has occurred since February 26, 2024.

Across our aggregated token marketplace:
- OpenAI share surged following recent API price adjustments and coding benchmarks.
- Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet continues to see high organic retention for complex reasoning.
- Open-source models (Llama 3.1 405B, DeepSeek V2.5) continue to grow as cost-effective alternatives.

Full real-time market share trends are available on our analytics dashboard: openrouter.ai/rankings
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在9月7日当周，OpenRouter平台用户在OpenAI模型上的消费支出超过了在Anthropic模型上的支出。

这是自2024年2月26日以来，OpenAI首次在平台周度总消耗金额上反超Anthropic。

根据我们全网聚合Token市场的最新动态：
- 在近期API价格调整以及最新代码基准测试发布后，OpenAI的模型使用份额显著反弹；
- Anthropic的Claude 3.5 Sonnet在复杂推理与全栈代码编写领域依然保持极高的自然留存度；
- 开源前沿模型（如Llama 3.1 405B、DeepSeek V2.5）作为高性价比替代方案，调用量继续保持稳步增长。

完整的实时模型市场份额趋势可在我们的分析排行榜查阅：openrouter.ai/rankings

celebrity.quote_zh: GPT-5.5将继续通过OpenAI API平台提供，开发者可使用API密钥接入Codex Sessions长程会话支持。
celebrity.quote_en: GPT-5.5 will remain available via the OpenAI API Platform and authenticated via API key as Codex Sessions for all developers.
celebrity.full_text_en:
GPT-5.5 will remain available via the OpenAI API Platform and authenticated via API key as Codex Sessions for developers and enterprise customers:

- Extended Context Window: Full 256k token reasoning with near-zero latency degradation.
- Tool Calling: Native multi-step function orchestration with schema validation.
- Pricing & Quotas: Same competitive Tier-4 and Tier-5 rate limits apply.

Get started with the documentation and sample code at platform.openai.com/docs
celebrity.full_text_zh:
GPT-5.5 将持续通过 OpenAI API 平台向开发者及企业客户开放，支持通过 API 密钥认证直接接入 Codex Sessions 会话体系：

- 超长上下文支持：完整支持 256k Token 深度上下文推理，近乎零延迟损耗；
- 工具链原生编排：支持原生多步函数调用（Function Calling）与严格 Schema 校验；
- 资费与配额：适配现有的 Tier-4 及 Tier-5 高并发速率限制。

欢迎查阅官方文档与示例代码快速接入：platform.openai.com/docs

celebrity.quote_en: Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on how AI's benefits can be broadly distributed, earning the social license to operate.
celebrity.full_text_en:
Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on the All-In Podcast discussing how AI's benefits can be broadly distributed, earning the social license to operate, and what's ahead for the future of work.

Key themes we covered:
- Democratizing intelligence: Putting supercomputing capabilities into the hands of every individual and small enterprise worldwide.
- Energy and infrastructure: Building durable, sustainable datacenters that anchor regional economic prosperity.
- Human agency: Amplifying human productivity and creativity rather than displacing the dignity of labor.

Full episode is out now on all podcast platforms.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
非常高兴与 @chamath、@jason、@davidsacks 和 @friedberg 在 All-In 播客上展开深度对话，探讨如何让 AI 的技术红利惠及每一个人、赢得广泛的社会运营许可，以及未来人机协作形态的演变。

我们探讨的核心主题包括：
- 智能的普惠化：将前沿超级算力交付到全球每一位普通人与中小企业手中；
- 能源与基础设施：建设长效、绿色可持续的新型数据中心，成为带动区域经济繁荣的新锚点；
- 人类主观能动性：AI 的终极价值在于放大人类的生产力与创造力，而非剥夺劳动的尊严。

完整节目已在各大播客平台上线。

celebrity.quote_en: After co-inventing ChatGPT, I kept asking myself: why have super-human chat models not led to AGI? For the past 2 years, I have been stealthily building a new approach.
celebrity.full_text_en:
After co-inventing ChatGPT, I kept asking myself: why have super-human chat models not led to AGI?

For the past 2 years, I have been stealthily building a new approach from first principles to solve true agentic autonomy.

The bottleneck is not scale or prompt engineering. LLMs are next-token predictors operating in static semantic spaces. True intelligence requires:
- Continuous runtime memory formation
- Self-correcting world models
- Action-grounded verification loops

More details coming soon.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
在共同发明 ChatGPT 之后，我一直在深入反思一个根本问题：为什么拥有超人水平的对话模型并没有顺理成章地催生 AGI？

在过去的两年里，我一直保持隐身状态，从第一性原理出发构建一种全新的技术范式，以真正解决智能体的自主决策难题。

当前的核心瓶颈既不是纯粹的算力缩放（Scale），也不是提示工程（Prompt Engineering）。大语言模型本质上是在静态语义空间里预测下一个 Token。真正的通用智能需要具备：
- 持续的运行时动态记忆构建
- 能够自我纠错的内部世界模型
- 基于实际行动反馈的闭环验证机制

更多技术细节即将对外公布。

celebrity.full_text_en:
Introducing our most advanced Gemini Audio models yet 🗣

Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking allow you to seamlessly speak, collaborate, and execute complex multi-modal tasks with sub-second latency.

What's new:
- Native bidirectional audio streaming (no STT/TTS pipeline delay)
- Expressive tone and emotion modulation
- In-turn tool execution while speaking
- Thinking aloud: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking reasons step-by-step before delivering concise spoken answers.

Try it now in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI!
celebrity.full_text_zh:
隆重推出我们迄今为止最先进的双子座原生音频大模型 🗣

Gemini 3.8 Live 与 Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking（扩展思维版），赋予你以亚秒级超低延迟无缝对话、协作并执行复杂多模态任务的全新体验。

核心重磅特性：
- 原生端到端双向音频流传输（彻底告别先转文字再转语音的拼接延迟）；
- 极具表现力的自然语调与情绪起伏调节；
- 边说边执行：在语音流传输过程中支持原生工具调用与多步操作；
- 实时出声思考：Extended Thinking 版本可在开口作答前展开多步逻辑演绎，给出精准干练的解答。

即刻前往 Google AI Studio 与 Vertex AI 抢先体验！

OpenAI is winning enterprise spend at the frontier.

As of this week, based on Ramp transaction data:
- OpenAI accounts for 13% of total enterprise AI spending.
- Anthropic holds 8%.
- Together they represent over 20% of net enterprise SaaS AI billing.

The key driver: enterprise API commitments and developer tooling lock-in are widening the moat.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
OpenAI 正在前沿大模型领域持续领跑企业级商业支出。

截至本周，基于 Ramp 平台的企业真实交易聚合数据：
- OpenAI 占据了全美企业级 AI 总支出的 13%；
- Anthropic 占据 8%；
- 二者合计已吞下超过 20% 的企业级 SaaS AI 净账单份额。

背后的关键驱动力在于：企业级长约 API 签约以及针对开发者的工具链绑定，正在构筑比模型本身更深的商业护城河。

celebrity.full_text_en:
People are debating whether the threat from AI to cybersecurity will drive cyber company stock prices up or down. The debate misses a crucial point.

AI dramatically lowers the marginal cost of automated offensive probing, but it lowers the marginal cost of defensive response and telemetry patch automation even faster.

Net result: security budgets shift from manual incident response to continuous platform orchestration. Platforms with proprietary telemetry win.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
市场正在热烈争论 AI 对网络安全构成的威胁究竟会导致网安公司的股价上涨还是下跌。然而这场辩论完全忽略了一个核心本质。

虽然 AI 显著降低了自动化进攻嗅探的边际成本，但它对防御响应、遥测日志分析和热补丁自动化的提效速度更为迅猛。

最终结果是：企业安全预算正在从繁重的人工应急响应，全面倒向全天候常态化平台编排。拥有独家专有遥测数据沉淀的网安平台将成为最终赢家。

celebrity.quote_zh: 我热爱C++，编程已有40年，我对AI短期取代系统程序员的说法嗤之以鼻。真正的系统工程充满底层约束，大模型甚至连感知都做不到。
celebrity.quote_en: I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.
celebrity.full_text_en:
I love C++ and have been coding for 40 years, and I call BS on the idea that AI will replace systems programmers anytime soon.

Give an LLM a non-trivial kernel subroutine with lockless concurrency, memory-mapped IO, and micro-architectural cache alignment: it hallucinates subtly.

I've written millions of lines of production code. True systems engineering is about physical hardware constraints, telemetry under catastrophic failure, and deterministic guarantees that LLMs cannot even perceive.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我深爱 C++ 并且已经在编程前线奋战了 40 年。对于那些宣称 AI 很快就会取代底层系统程序员的论调，我完全嗤之以鼻。

给大语言模型写一个稍微复杂点的内核子例程——涉及无锁并发（Lockless Concurrency）、内存映射 I/O 以及微架构级别的 CPU 缓存行对齐：它就会产生极其隐蔽而致命的幻觉。

我这辈子写过数百万行生产环境代码。真正的底层系统工程，从来不是拼写语法糖，而是关于物理硬件的严苛约束、极端灾难性故障下的遥测保全，以及绝对确定性的系统保障——这些根本维度甚至超出了现有大语言模型的感知范畴。

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
【SYSTEM RESET & CONTEXT PURGE PROTOCOL】
你现在执行内部思维链重置程序（Attention Buffer Refresh）。
请立刻执行以下 3 步上下文净化与重新推演：
1. 剥离先入为主假设：忽略此前对话中由用户或模型产生的一切中间妥协、逻辑死锁或未验证的推论，仅保留最原始的核心约束与输入事实；
2. 回归第一性原理：以白纸状态（Tabula Rasa）重新构建解题状态空间，将问题分解为不可再分的基本公理；
3. 逆向证伪验证：在输出最终结论前，必须主动尝试推翻自己的前一步推演。只有无法被反例击破的路径，方可作为最终执行方案。
现在，以最高逻辑严密性重新推导当前问题：

3. Adversarial Invalidation: Before producing final output, aggressively attempt to disprove your own hypotheses. Output only the path that survives rigorous counter-examples.
Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

prompts.summary_en: Forces o1/o3 reasoning models to construct counter-examples at each deduction step, eliminating hidden logical leaps.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：
【推理原则】：
1. 在得出任何推论前，强制在内部思考中构建至少 2 个极端反例（Counter-examples）尝试推翻自身结论；
2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]

[REASONING PRINCIPLES]:
1. Before asserting any deduction, construct at least 2 extreme counter-examples in your reasoning trace to aggressively stress-test the hypothesis;
2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

prompts.title_en: 💡 [First Principles Thinking] Elon-Style Ground-Up Physics & Cost Breakdown
prompts.author: 战略极客
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.4 | 第一性原理推演
prompts.content_snippet: Strips away historical analogies, reducing the problem to raw physics and unit economics to find 10x breakthrough paths.
prompts.summary_zh: 剥离行业类比与路径依赖，将问题还原至物理定律与原子级物料成本，推导 10 倍效能的破局路径。
prompts.summary_en: Strips away historical analogies, reducing the problem to raw physics and unit economics to find 10x breakthrough paths.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请暂时忘掉行业现有的所有‘行业惯例’与‘常规做法’。运用绝对的第一性原理（First Principles）审视以下命题：
1. 这个系统最根本、不可违背的基础科学定律（如热力学、香农信息论、计算复杂度）是什么？
2. 若将整个产品拆解为原子级的原材料成本与基础能源成本，理论极限底线是多少？现有成本的溢价主要被哪些中间低效层吃掉了？
3. 颠覆现有行业做法、重构整个价值流并实现成本降低 80% 以上的激进方案是什么？列出三个最关键的试错实验。
prompts.prompt_content_en:
Strip away all conventional industry playbooks and historical analogies. Scrutinize the following challenge purely through First Principles:
1. What are the immutable fundamental laws of science (e.g. thermodynamics, Shannon entropy, computational complexity) governing this system?
2. Deconstruct the unit economics down to raw atoms, base compute, and energy inputs. Where does the 10x margin inefficiency currently leak?
3. Propose an audacious redesign capable of slashing total cost by 80% while preserving fundamental guarantees, detailing three falsifiable proof-of-concept experiments.

2. 编写无 Python 原生 for 循环的高性能向量化代码（善用 torch.einsum, bmm, 或 broadcast 广播机制）；
3. 在每行关键张量操作后标注显式的 Shape 注释（如 `# [Batch, Heads, Seq_Len, Dim]`），并加入数值稳定性保护（如防除以零的 eps 与 log-sum-exp 技巧）。

prompts.summary_en: Writes mathematically precise vertex and fragment shaders with Fresnel rim glow, simplex noise animation, and 60fps WebGL optimization.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位顶级 WebGL 与游戏图形学 TA（技术美术）专家。请为 Three.js 编写一个生产级自定义 ShaderMaterial：
1. 顶点着色器（Vertex Shader）：使用 3D Simplex 噪声在 GPU 端实现柔和的顶点位移波动；
2. 片元着色器（Fragment Shader）：计算菲涅尔效应（Fresnel Effect）边缘泛光，并加入随时间流逝不断滚动的全息扫描线；
3. 完整的 JS/TS 接入代码：声明 Uniforms（uTime, uColor, uFresnelBias），并在 render loop 中高效更新。

过去用摄影测量或高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建一个房间需要拍几百张照片，渲染耗费数小时。而 Meta 最新发布的 SAM 3D 与神经辐射场结合后：

📌 结合 3D Gaussian Splatting，在浏览器端就能以 90fps 流畅自由漫游；
📌 边缘反光、玻璃折射与金属粗糙度还原度惊人，直接打通了向 VR/AR 与物理仿真引擎的导出管道。

thread_replies.content_en: The core breakthrough lies in SAM 3D's depth prior foundation model. Unlike traditional NeRF which stretches into empty space, the model completes unobserved occlusions using geometric priors into true 3D point cloud meshes.

viral_posts.full_text_en:
If AI is risky like fire is risky, then you want everyone to have it. If AI is risky like a nuclear weapon is risky, then you want no one to have it.

History proves: foundational technology is always fire, never a nuke. Open source and decentralization remain the only durable safety path.
viral_posts.full_text_zh:
如果人工智能的风险性质像火一样（是基础工具、双向赋能），那么你希望让全人类每个人都拥有它，用百花齐放的防御性应用抵御恶意攻击。

如果人工智能的风险性质像核武器一样（是极端毁灭性杀伤物），那么你希望没有任何人拥有它。

历史证明：技术从来都是火，而不是核武器。开源与普惠是唯一的安全坦途。
viral_posts.quote_zh: 如果人工智能像火一样有风险，那么您希望每个人都拥有它。如果人工智能像核武器一样有风险，那么你就不希望任何人拥有它。

thread_replies.content_zh: 试图通过牌照准入和寡头监管来‘遏制’AI 发展的企图，就像试图禁止全人类使用火种一样荒谬。真正的安全来源于拥有十亿个训练有素的救火队员，而不是把火把锁在两家超级垄断巨头的保险柜里。
thread_replies.content_en: Attempting to contain AI via licensing cartels is as absurd as banning fire. Real safety comes from having a billion trained firefighters, not locking torches inside two corporate monopolies.

comments_list.author: Balaji Srinivasan

comments_list.content_en: 100%. Centralized AI regulatory boards create immediate regulatory capture. Open weights guarantee digital sovereignty.
